find -L /app -maxdepth 3 -type f 2>/dev/null | head -100

sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /app && python3 merge_users.py
echo "=== exit: $? ==="
ls -la /app/merged_users.parquet /app/conflicts.json
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /app
echo "=== conflicts.json ==="
cat conflicts.json
echo
echo "=== verification ==="
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
import pandas as pd
import pyarrow.parquet as pq

df = pd.read_parquet('/app/merged_users.parquet')
print("Schema from Arrow:")
print(pq.read_schema('/app/merged_users.parquet'))
print("\nData:")
print(df)
print("\nDtypes:")
print(df.dtypes)

with open('/app/conflicts.json') as f:
    rep = json.load(f)

# Assertions
assert list(df.columns) == ['user_id','name','email','created_date','status'], df.columns
assert str(df['user_id'].dtype) == 'int64'
assert sorted(df['user_id'].tolist()) == [101,102,103,104], df['user_id'].tolist()
assert rep['total_conflicts'] == len(rep['conflicts']) == 3, rep['total_conflicts']

row = df.set_index('user_id')
assert row.loc[101,'name'] == 'John Doe'
assert row.loc[101,'email'] == 'john@a.com'
assert row.loc[101,'created_date'] == '2024-01-15'
assert row.loc[101,'status'] == 'active'
assert row.loc[102,'status'] == 'inactive'
assert row.loc[103,'name'] == 'Bob Wilson' and row.loc[103,'email'] == 'bob@b.com'
assert row.loc[104,'name'] == 'Alice Brown' and row.loc[104,'email'] == 'alice@c.com'
for _, c in rep['conflicts']:
    assert c['selected'] == c['values']['source_a']  # highest priority wins
    assert c['field'] in {'name','email','created_date','status'}
# All dates YYYY-MM-DD
import re
for d in df['created_date']:
    assert re.fullmatch(r'\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}', d), d
print("\nALL ASSERTIONS PASSED")
PY
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /app
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, re
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_parquet('/app/merged_users.parquet')
with open('/app/conflicts.json') as f:
    rep = json.load(f)

assert list(df.columns) == ['user_id','name','email','created_date','status']
assert str(df['user_id'].dtype) == 'int64'
assert sorted(df['user_id'].tolist()) == [101,102,103,104]
assert rep['total_conflicts'] == len(rep['conflicts']) == 3

row = df.set_index('user_id')
assert row.loc[101,'name'] == 'John Doe'
assert row.loc[101,'email'] == 'john@a.com'
assert row.loc[101,'created_date'] == '2024-01-15'
assert row.loc[101,'status'] == 'active'
assert row.loc[102,'status'] == 'inactive'
assert row.loc[103,'name'] == 'Bob Wilson' and row.loc[103,'email'] == 'bob@b.com'
assert row.loc[104,'name'] == 'Alice Brown' and row.loc[104,'email'] == 'alice@c.com'
for c in rep['conflicts']:
    assert c['selected'] == c['values']['source_a']
    assert c['field'] in {'name','email','created_date','status'}
    assert isinstance(c['user_id'], int)
for d in df['created_date']:
    assert re.fullmatch(r'\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}', d), d
print("ALL ASSERTIONS PASSED")
PY
EOF
